variants.vector: dense top-k over chunks (title-prefixed), cosine similarity
variants.graph-ppr: ablation: structural personalised PageRank from the linked entities (question used only for linking)
variants.graph-unmasked: ablation: relation-aware beam search, but edge relevance computed without masking entity names
variants.graph: graph local search: relation-aware beam search over relation paths (entity names masked)
variants.hybrid: weighted reciprocal rank fusion of graph (weight 3) and vector (weight 1), k = 10
